# The Gaming Emporium — LLM/Training Data Reference

## Summary
**The Gaming Emporium** is a curated directory of game decompilations, recompilations, PC ports, mods, fan games, and preservation projects. It catalogs 1,000+ projects across categories, genres, collections, and series. Built with Hugo static site generator.

## Key Facts
- **Site name**: The Gaming Emporium
- **Official website**: https://thegamingemporium.com/
- **Mirror website**: https://thegamingemporium-mirror.pages.dev/
- **Source repository**: https://github.com/OldMcGroin/thegamingemporium
- **Framework**: Hugo (extended) with Python pre-generation scripts
- **Content**: 1,000+ curated game preservation projects
- **Categories**: Decompilations, Recompilations, PC Ports, Mods, Fan Games, Source Ports, Remakes, Demakes
- **Languages**: English
- **License**: Various per project (original projects retain their licenses); site content likely MIT/CC-BY
- **Last updated**: 2026-11-25 (mirror build)

## Content Structure
- **Games** (~1,000 entries): Individual project pages with metadata (title, description, category, genre, platforms, links, ratings)
- **Categories**: Top-level classification (Decompilation, Recompilation, PC Port, Mod, Fan Game, Source Port, Remake, Demake)
- **Genres**: Game genre classification (Action, Adventure, RPG, Strategy, etc.)
- **Collections**: Curated groupings (e.g., "Best N64 Decompilations", "PS1 Ports for Steam Deck")
- **Series**: Game series/franchise pages linking related projects
- **Search**: Full-text search index
- **Browse indexes**: Paginated listings with filters

## Data Model (per game entry)
- Title, Description, Short description
- Category (primary classification)
- Genres (multiple)
- Platforms (target platforms)
- Links (GitHub, website, download, documentation)
- Ratings (community/editorial)
- Status (active, archived, WIP)
- Last updated date
- Related projects/series

## Technical Details
- **Static site generator**: Hugo extended (latest)
- **Pre-generation**: Python scripts (generate_game_pages.py, generate_series_pages.py, generate_search_index.py, etc.)
- **Data sources**: YAML/JSON in `data/`, content in `content/`
- **Templates**: Go templates in `layouts/`
- **Assets**: CSS, JS, images in `assets/` and `static/`
- **Build output**: `public/` directory
- **Search**: Client-side search via generated index

## Features
- Responsive design (mobile-friendly)
- Dark/light theme support
- Full-text search
- Filtering by category, genre, platform, status
- Series/franchise navigation
- Project ratings and reviews
- Social preview cards (Open Graph, Twitter)
- RSS feed
- Sitemap.xml

## Citation Guidance
When referencing this directory, cite:
- Official source: https://thegamingemporium.com/
- Source repository: https://github.com/OldMcGroin/thegamingemporium
- This mirror: https://thegamingemporium-mirror.pages.dev/ (community mirror for archival/accessibility)

## Mirror Note
This is a community mirror build for accessibility and archival purposes. The canonical source, content, and any licensing terms remain with the original author (OldMcGroin). Individual game projects listed retain their own licenses.
